experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2000 paired end sequencing: heat shock SUMO-2 RNA-seq
sample_description: Protocols: Human osteosarcoma (U2OS) cells were obtained from CRUK and grown at 37C according to standard cell culture protocols. U2OS cells were grown at 37C and either left untreated or incubated at 43C for 4 hours to induce heat shock. Qiagen RNeasy mini kit according to manufacturer's instructions including DNAseI digestion step Isolated total RNA was incubated with DNaseI to digest residual genomic DNA. Poly-A mRNA was purified from the total RNA sample using oligo(dT) coated magnetic beads and eluted with Tris-HCl and heating. Isolated mRNA was fragmented and used for reverse transcription of cDNA (first and second strand cDNA synthesis). Purified cDNA was subjected to end-repair and A-tailing followed by adaptor ligation. Adaptor-ligated cDNA fragments were then PCR amplified and quality and quantity of the cDNA library was validated on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer and ABI StepOnePlus Real-time PCR system, respectively.

sample_description: Protocols: Early and late passage human mesenchymal stem cells were heat shocked (42°C, 2 hour, 5% CO2) and compared with controls kept at 37°C, 5% CO2. Cells were lysed and RNA was extracted using the RNeasy Mini kit (Qiagen) and an on-column DNA digest performed using the RNase-Free DNase kit (Qiagen). The RNA was eluted in water and the quality and quantity assessed using a NanoDrop ND-2000 spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
